jira.label: Jira / Atlassian
jira.product_group_note: Confirmed 14 Aug 2026 via GET /rest/api/3/user/groups on the site admin account - this is the JSM/Support product-access group on buffett-dev (groupId 7f60582b-683f-47de-8611-b6f0e0769866). A leaver may also hold jira-users-buffett-dev (base Jira Software access); remove_product_access only removes the one configured group, so a leaver in both groups keeps base Jira access after reclaim - out of scope for v1 (JSM seat is the billed product). remove_product_access is tried first (works with a manage:jira-configuration-scoped API token); deactivate_user is a best-effort second attempt that requires org-admin API access, which personal/non-domain-claimed Atlassian sites like this one likely do not have.
